environment.region: none, loopback; handler default us-central1 unmeasured
environment.invocation: real callable .run and service workers in one local Node process; excludes HTTP/auth/network/cold start and scheduled wait
environment.readMetric: transaction snapshot requests; includes retries, missing documents and repeated reads; excludes index-entry/billing accounting, setup/poll reconciliation reads and worker reads outside transactions

revokeAndDeletion.email: development mailbox sent to other guardian, revoked parent cancelled before send
revokeAndDeletion.deletion: deny first, one-page interruption, service resume, Auth deleted, other guardian and organization history survive
